source.what: One real Monero mainnet block, as a monerod served it over json_rpc get_block.
source.daemonVersion: the node answered get_info with no version string
source.transport: curl --socks5-hostname via 127.0.0.1:9050 (Tor; the node saw a Tor exit, not this machine)
source.note: The node is a stranger's server and its claims are recorded as claims. What the fixture pins is the bytes; the id and the chain link are proven by this repository's own parser in test/monero-block.test.mjs, against the id recorded here.

parent.note: The child blob's header must name this id — checked at capture and re-proven by the test.
